scope: All 192 primary blocks, all 54 D12 clauses and corresponding case actions, eight U obligations and all 76 proposed cases reviewed. Approval is restricted to explicit partial documentary workflow roles.

sources.declared_version: Ableton Reference Manual Version 12; exact 12.4.3 applicability U
Ableton Reference Manual Version 12; exact 12.4.3 applicability U

checks.derivation: Independent HTMLParser reproduction matched block kind/text, HTML line, anchor, section, heading context and locator; both line views equal.
checks.requirement_case_evidence: Unique IDs, full requirement-to-case coverage, exact requirement source-block equality in cases, source resolution, contract equality and all case-index rows passed.
checks.positive_prerequisites: Every case names F0 and positive-path-gate. Fixture definitions require actual eligible target/path, nonempty source, nonzero base/depth/amount/gain/send, nonmuted wet output and matched positive trial. Recording additionally requires admitted excursion, Automation Arm/appropriate record and running transport.
checks.untracked_aware_authored_whitespace: Pass for all authored text/code/JSON, manifest and both canonicals; immutable HTML hash-checked.
checks.author_validator: Read validate.py and pure source_parser.py before executing only python -B validate.py. Exit 0 without stderr; JSON pass confirms sealed manifest, writes:false and no original/candidate execution. No author script or finite evaluator executed, and no result file was written.

semantic_review.finite_authority_boundary: Existing automation-envelope REQ013 remains U, including recorded points/Ids, override persistence, Undo and stored LockEnvelope/transforms. Logic-side E(t), engine point-list playback, UI values, song/clip time and normalization are kept distinct. Existing mix-graph A3/A6/A8 and unit/owner assumptions are not broadened. The 21-case finite storage release and all pinned authorities remain byte-identical; no finite mapping, curve, ramp or fader coefficient is promoted to new workflow output.
semantic_review.001_007_recording_and_overwrite: automation:B003-B021 support theme-qualified indicators, Session Automation Arm/track-arm versus explicit All Tracks preference, Session Record and stop controls, Session-to-Arrangement ownership, all-track Arrangement recording and first-pass/overwrite input contexts. Record-start default wording is qualified by actual running transport rather than overriding the recording owner preference. AW-002/003/004/005/006 require changing accepted parameters and positive source/envelope states. Touch/latch and recorded event/overwrite boundaries are null timing/recording probes, not controller or sampling laws.
semantic_review.008_010_override_and_reenable: automation:B023-B027 distinguish nonrecording manual override from recording overwrite, gray/active indicators, global versus one-parameter re-enable and Session relaunch. AW-008/009 use two independently active envelopes and record-off state; return value/audio timing remains null. Re-Enable Automation is explicitly distinct from Back to Arrangement, and relaunch supplies no universal launch/target reset boundary.
semantic_review.011_019_choosers_filters_and_lanes: automation:B031-B057 support Session/Arrangement chooser distinctions, combined filters, already-displayed untouched exception, stacked-view focus, None, adding/moving/hiding/reordering/promoting lanes, existing-target focus, duplicate limit, all-lane and selected/below removal. Case actions preserve platform modifier context and lane versus underlying-data distinction. A documented lane limit is not multiple independent automation sources; exact pixels/target availability and gesture branches remain partial.
semantic_review.020_025_creation_draw_and_shapes: automation:B059-B074 support point insertion, displayed values, Add Value, grid bypass, discrete stepped presentation, Draw Mode, visible-grid steps and source-named shapes with selection/grid/parameter extent roles. Only square shape is offered for discrete targets. These are visible editing roles, not event serialization, Bool/Enum runtime interpolation, sampled sine/ADSR kernels or cross-domain normalization.
semantic_review.026_032_point_segment_transform_and_simp: automation:B079-B097 support point/selection deletion, segment movement and added selection-edge points, drag preview versus committed overwrite, diagonal-only curves, typed value/relative selection, stretch/skew/mirrored handles and outside-point removal. Case values stay admitted with headroom. No curve equation, affine transform, endpoint ownership, clamp/parser, Escape rollback, transaction or Simplify optimum/error bound/count is inferred.
semantic_review.033_037_clear_tempo_lock_and_edit_scope: automation:B099-B114 support parameter Delete Automation/visible default, clear scopes, Main Song Tempo and mapped-range role, public Lock Envelopes entry and selected-envelope Edit scope/target transfer. Default identity is independently retained, not a guessed number. Arrangement REQ032 keeps lock-on movement; no stored LockEnvelope meaning or lock-off law is added. Tempo range gives no controller normalization or clock/precedence law; unrelated-target paste has no conversion equation.
semantic_review.038_042_clip_types_clear_reset_and_nonde: clip-envelopes:B004-B018/B038-B041 support audio versus MIDI chooser entries, Session Automation/Modulation versus Arrangement modulation-only Clip View and absolute/current-relative roles without a universal combiner. Clip Clear uses the explicit context menu; Auto-Reset remains certain unspecified messages/values. Non-destructive sample modulation is a source role with null signal comparator; render/resample/consolidation remain owned elsewhere.
semantic_review.043_049_audio_modulation_roles: clip-envelopes:B020-B049 support Warp-dependent sample transposition, Clip Gain attenuation ceiling, Beats-only Sample Offset eligibility, separate post-effect Track Volume target/dot, send ceiling, contextual pan span and device relative modulation. Source example ranges, tape-head story and sound recipes are not DSP or beat/sample equations. Gain/send/device probes use enabled nonzero base/amount, known active wet/output and paired positive paths. Pan no-effect at full-left is attempted only after positive centered modulation. Numerical delivered values and sound remain null.
semantic_review.050_054_MIDI_local_regions_and_Warp: clip-envelopes:B051-B078 support editing listed MIDI controllers, most numbers through 119 and receiver-name caveats; no full controller set, reset table or codec is inferred. Unlinked local Loop/region controls are independent of sample Loop, with individual lengths/start/zoom-grid context and short/long rhythmic roles. These do not establish clip-time equations, restart phase, oscillator design or event scheduling. Linked Warp interaction is visible-relative only; exact envelope/marker conversion remains unknown or with the finite Warp owner.
semantic_review.Q_AW_001_shortcut_focus: automation:B099 direct parameter Delete Automation and clip-envelopes:B011 shortcut-to-menu wording are both retained. Positive clip clear uses context menu; separate parameter/editor/lane shortcut probe remains U with actual focus/build prerequisites.
semantic_review.Q_AW_002_replacement_context: clip-envelopes:B036 all-settings wording is not broadened into unequal-duration marker retention over Clip View REQ041. Equal/different-length source, envelope and Warp-marker inventories are retained separately in an ungraded replacement probe; sealed owner remains unchanged.
semantic_review.Q_AW_003_MIDI_and_ranges: Unspecified Auto-Reset messages/values, most controller numbers through 119 and tempo assigned-controller range are source contexts only. No MIDI bytes, takeover, exact list, normalization, reset/default timing or clock law is fabricated.
semantic_review.future_assets_and_closure: No ALS/WAV/MIDI/controller/reference assets, accepted hardware or runtime outputs are supplied. Unsupported target/controller, silent source, zero send, inactive automation or missing monitoring path cannot prove exclusion. Eight U obligations and operational probes preserve malformed/empty/edge/crossing, inactive gates, undo/cancel/save, transport/rate, loss, concurrency and teardown unknowns. Compound visible clauses and entrypoint branches remain partial.
